description: This file contains Makefile rules and macro definitions for building the root filesystem for an OpenWrt-based embedded system, including optional libraries, package management commands (opkg, apk), and functions for preparing and cleaning the root filesystem.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes package-specific files and resets package status, used to clean the package manager state on the root filesystem.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem by copying files, running post-install scripts, enabling/disabling init scripts, and cleaning temporary build artifacts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Builds and strips shared libraries and executables specified in the build environment for static linking.
